capabilities: Color notes with nine presets or any hex color
Pin notes above folders in the file explorer
Set one-off and repeating reminders with an end date
Pin a note to the Android notification bar
Turn selected text into a reminder notification
extras: The Android companion app is free on Google Play, F-Droid and GitHub Releases; there are no notifications on iPhone or iPad. Sorting the file explorer by color is marked experimental and relies on behaviour Obsidian does not officially support.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to color notes, keep often-used notes above folders, or get repeating reminders that fire on time.

relations.evidence: you can see it, edit it, and use it in Bases or Dataview

requires.name: Note Pin for Obsidian (Android companion app)

summary: Colors notes, pins them above folders in the file explorer, and sets repeating reminders, with an Android app for notification-bar pins.
